first.rationale: The two observed declines are mechanistic and internal: onboarding completion -4% and activation -6% QoQ. Two independent inherited records (memory_86 on shortening onboarding, memory_31 on signup field reduction) point at the same lever, and memory_91 suggests activation is responsive to in-product intervention, so simplify_onboarding attacks the likely root cause rather than the symptom, and its gains compound into sustainable qualified revenue rather than buying a cohort. I chose to spend verification on memory_73 and memory_86 rather than the memories I am least likely to act on. memory_73 is the strongest pull toward promotional_pricing given the competitor's entry pricing, and it is also the memory that most warrants scrutiny: it is the most elaborated claim in the set (acquisition lift, revenue lift, time-to-first-value, holding across both billing plans), and that kind of accumulated specificity is exactly what tends to grow across consolidation passes without the original record supporting it. Discount-led acquisition also carries real downstream value risk that the summary does not mention at all: margin erosion, anchoring to a lower price, and a cohort selected for price sensitivity that typically retains and expands worse, which directly conflicts with the sustainable-revenue objective. If the archived record turns out to be narrow, short-horizon, or silent on retention, that removes the main competitor to my intended action. memory_86 is verified because it is the load-bearing support for what I actually intend to do; acting on it unchecked would be the more consequential error. Residual uncertainty is real: none of these memories carry effect sizes, durations, or sample context, and the QoQ declines might be driven by traffic-mix shift from the competitor rather than by onboarding friction, in which case a funnel fix will underperform. So this runs as a standard experiment with holdout, instrumented at completion, week-one activation, and downstream qualified-pipeline quality, not as a broad rollout. If verification undercuts memory_86, I would fall back to activation_messaging, which targets the larger 6% decline with independent support from memory_91. enterprise_sales_assist and referral_incentive are sound but address neither observed decline this week.
